meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

meanings.note: In questions. Core Russian det meaning 'what; what a' in everyday speech.

ложиться.gloss: to lie down, go to bed

meanings.en: to lie down, go to bed
meanings.note: Ложиться спать = to go to bed. Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to lie down, go to bed', paired with 'лечь'.

examples.trans: Let's go into the ward, go to bed.
The children go to bed early.

examples.text: Ложись спать, тебе надо хорошо отдохнуть.
examples.trans: Go to sleep, you need to rest well.

meanings.note: лучший в мире = the best in the world
Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('best; better').

examples.trans: You give me five hundred roubles, and I get out and buy you the best console in the world.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'пать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to sleep', paired with 'поспать'.

meanings.note: Спокойной ночи = good night. Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'покойный'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('calm, quiet').
